TF3-EN
ATX 3.1 & PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready
Unlocking the Power of the Future
Ready for Next-Gen Hardware
The Toughpower TF3 Titanium 1300W delivers outstanding 80 PLUS Titanium efficiency, designed to meet the demands of modern high-performance
systems. Equipped with two native 12V-2x6 modular connectors, it supports PCIe 12+4 pin RTX 50 & 40 series cards, making it fully compatible
with next-generation PCIe 5.1 graphics cards. Built to adhere to Intel ATX 3.1 specifications, this power supply ensures superior reliability
and future-ready compatibility for cutting-edge hardware.
Fully Compatible with ATX 3.1 Standards
The Toughpower TF3 1300W is fully compatible with ATX 3.1 specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches 60% efficiency at
low load and complies with required power supply timing standards.

PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready
Dual Native 12V-2x6 Connectors
The Toughpower TF3 1300W features two native PCIe 12V-2x6 connectors and includes two PCIe 12+4 pin cables, providing powerful and
stable performance to meet the power demands of next-generation PCIe Gen 5.1 graphics cards.
The wattage marked on the PCIe 12V-2X6’s cable is the recommended wattage. (Ref. Intel design guideline) The native PCIe 12V-2X6
connectors of the Toughpower TF3 1300W can deliver up to 600W for PCIe 5.1 graphics cards.
Note:
Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage,
and many other factors.
Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the 12V-2X6 cable.
PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready
Dual-Color 12+4pin Cable
The cable connectors feature a dual-color design with a Matcha Green color scheme, reducing installation errors and helping users
easily determine whether the cables are properly connected.
Previous
Next
Made to Comply with the Latest Graphics Cards
As the power consumption of graphics cards increase, so has their demand for power. The Toughpwer TF3 1300W is designed to support NVIDIA and
AMD graphics cards, it supports 8-pin PCIe cables for AMD graphics cards & RTX series graphics cards, it also comes with 2 x PCIe 12V-2X6
connectors for RTX 50 & 40 series cards that need a PCIe Gen 5.1 connector, ready to supply the graphics cards according to their different
ways of connections.
1 x 8-pin GPU Power Connector
2 x 8-pin GPU Power Connector
3 x 8-pin GPU Power Connector
2 x 12V-2X6 GPU Power Connectors
Unlock Peak Overclocking Performance
Manual Overclocking Mode Switch
The OCM switch gives you the power to optimize your system's performance with ease. By default, the power supply operates in Multi-Rail mode
with Over Current Protection (OCP) to ensure maximum safety for your components. For overclocking enthusiasts, a simple press of the OCM
switch transitions the power supply to Single 12V rail mode, unleashing enhanced power delivery when you need it most.
*The OCM switch can only be activated when the system is powered off.
80 PLUS Titanium Certified
80 PLUS Titanium certification means the Toughpower TF3 converts power efficiently, saves energy through its high efficiency up to 94%,
resulting in lower power loss and heat buildup inside the power supply.
Thermaltake Customized Cooling Fan
The Toughpower TF3 1300W features the Thermaltake customized cooling fan, it is designed with specially tuned fan blades to push air further.
More Stable than Ever
100% high quality Japanese 105°C/221°F electrolytic capacitors provides great durability as well as offering the highest stability, while
remaining reliable.
High-Class Technologies
The use of LLC and DC to DC circuit design provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.
